title: ASC 980 – Regulated Operations
summary: Governs regulatory asset and liability recognition for rate-regulated entities including discontinuation of regulatory accounting.
description: ASC 980 establishes a three-part recognition test for regulatory assets and addresses regulatory liabilities, as well as discontinuation of regulatory asset recognition. It keyly diverges from IFRS 14, which provides a narrower interim model rather than a universal regulatory accounting framework.

bannerNotice.title: Divergence from IFRS 14
bannerNotice.body: ASC 980 provides a comprehensive regulatory accounting model, while IFRS 14 is a narrow interim standard only. The universality of ASC 980's approach contrasts sharply with IFRS 14's limited temporary relief.
